chunks: They will be served the choicest wine, sealed
ai.seo_question: What is the 'sealed wine' (Rahiq Makhtum) that the inhabitants of Paradise will drink?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this 'sealed nectar' (Rahiq Makhtum) from Surah Al-Mutaffifin is often contrasted with the intoxicants of this world, emphasizing its purity from both physical impurities and the mental confusion of wine. The sealing signifies its preservation from spoilage and its exclusive nature for the righteous, reflecting the divine promise of refined, eternal bliss. This description underscores the spiritual and physical perfection of Paradise's rewards for those who were faithful in their deeds.
